messages.htmlBody:
Celebrate being 2M cards strong!

To celebrate being 2 Million Cards Strong, we're giving away a total of 2 million UB Rewards across 20 cardholders (points, miles, or rebates).

From May 15 to June 15, 2026, every swipe brings you closer to bonus rewards.

Here's how to join:

1. Register — Register your unique code GV6MWQ on UnionBank Treats Hub to join the promo.

2. Spend — Spend a minimum accumulated amount of ₱5,000 using your UnionBank Credit Card during the promo period.

3. Earn entries — Get 1 raffle entry for every ₱1,000 accumulated spend. The more you spend, the more chances you get to win.

20 winners will be drawn to receive bonus UB Rewards (points, miles, or rebates).

Visit unionbankph.com/2MRewardspromo for full promo details.

Register Now

Terms & conditions apply. Per DTI Fair Trade Permit No. FTEB-255052 Series of 2026

This email was sent by: UnionBank of the Philippines, UnionBank Plaza Building, San Antonio Pasig, Metro Manila, 1605, PH.
